title: Aromatic Thai Vermicelli Pasta
description: A flavorful and aromatic vegetarian dish featuring vermicelli pasta, grilled yakimono vegetables, and a creamy cheese pull.

ingredients.name: Yakimono Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Bell peppers, carrots, mushrooms, and onions.

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the gochujang sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and ginger paste. Cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
While the sauce is simmering, prepare the yakimono skewers by threading bell peppers, carrots, mushrooms, and onions onto each skewer.
Grill the yakimono skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
Add the grilled skewers to the sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until coated.
Cook the vermicelli pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a separate saucepan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the grated parmesan cheese and cook until melted and bubbly.
Add the chopped green chilies and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the cooked vermicelli pasta onto a plate, followed by a portion of the grilled yakimono vegetables and a sprinkle of parmesan cheese.
Top with a slice of mozzarella cheese and place under the broiler until melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro and green chilies if desired.
